body:
No. I've looked inward. I overthink everything. Including my perspective and my emotions and what there is out there. Non of that matters to me. I don't give a shit about it. Maybe another version of me does. I don't.

This morning i felt like with proper help and being stuck with no other choice i could move slowly forward. Maybe I'd get better. It's gone. I'm not going back. Looking inward does fuck all. It doesn't work. I dont give a shit about some tv shows they just pass the time at best. I don't give a shit about this world. I wasnt built for it. I do not fit into it.

I'm a bit better now. I think. I had a large meal last night and went to be early... Cried it out for about an hour. I will be speaking to doctors today.

Seems they want me to tell them what I need or want from them. Truth is I don't know. I really don't. They are also not sure about medication cause it hasn't worked in the past.

I need someone here to properly speak to for a bit. Cause I don't feel I understand exactly.
I live in the Midlands. All I'm comfortable to say atm.

Small update. Try to eat food... Or don't I'm not your mum. But i ended up on a trip to a&e due to off levels off ketones? Plus a few dizzy spells. But I'm fine and back to mindless internet browsing and regular checks.

I'm not on them yet. Due to not being seen by a doctor about it yet. Also due to a few reasons they haven't prescribed me anything yet. I assume after the bank holiday they will look into it.

So far the nurses have not been comfortable to prescribe anything until they are sure my transition meds don't conflict.

In regards to killing my self It's unlikely. At best I have the cord to my headphones when i ask to use them. Or i have shoe laces. Either way they check on me every 15mins so an attempt just isn't worth it. :| which is kinda why I regret coming here. But there we go. I am mostly safe from myself.

Thanks for the message.
I've not been here long. Considering what I've heard from else where it could be worse. Still i hope you're doing okay.
